summary: Frontend-only regression for Scanner-vs-Pintasan conflict fix on Transaksi. All 5 CORE acceptance criteria verified on the live web preview using seed products (custom product creation via UI was blocked by the Miko mascot bubble overlay, but seed products with barcodes were sufficient to exercise the scanner path end-to-end). VERIFIED: (1) Single scan adds ONE line and focus returns to scan-mode-input. (2) 10 consecutive scans of the same barcode produce quantity EXACTLY 10 — no double-processing. (3) Unknown barcode 'ZZZ' shows the exact toast 'Barcode tidak ditemukan.', DOES NOT open the variant popup, and does NOT substitute a Pintasan product; focus returns to scan-mode-input. (4) Mixed 25-operation sequence (scans interleaved with Pintasan quick-chip TAPs) produced exactly the expected per-product quantities (bc1_scans + TAP0 chip_taps for product1; bc2_scans + TAP1 chip_taps for product2) — chips add ONLY their own product and never merge with the last scanned barcode. (5) Identical-barcode rapid duplicate scan (two Enter presses within <350ms) increments the quantity by exactly 1, confirming the 350ms dedup guard. Screen focus stayed on 'scan-mode-input' throughout, and the variant popup 'Pilih Variasi' never appeared for Biasa/Grosir products. Not tested via automation (blocked by mascot overlay during product creation): the specific G1 grosir tier price @10=Rp18.000, V1 Variasi popup title 'Pilih Variasi Kopi', A1/A2 Variasi Barcode direct-add. Code review of those paths confirms correctness (submitBarcode uses familyOptions -> matchedVar branch for varbarcode; children/variations branch opens popup for classic Variasi; tierPrice recompute happens in cart layer).

critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/index.tsx submitBarcode: correctly uses processingRef.current guard + lastScanRef 350ms dedup for identical codes; refocus in finally with 100ms setTimeout — exactly the required no-double-processing behavior.
(tabs)/index.tsx: Pintasan Pressable chips have focusable={false} — this prevents the chip DOM element from stealing focus from scan-mode-input when tapped, matching requirement #2.

(tabs)/index.tsx: quick chip onPress -> onQuickTap -> either open variant popup (if product has children/variations) OR cart.addProduct + refocusScanner. It never reads scan-mode-input's buffer, so a chip tap can never mix with an in-flight scan.

(tabs)/index.tsx submitBarcode error branch: on getByBarcode reject, only toasts 'Barcode tidak ditemukan.' and emits mikoBus not_found — DOES NOT open variant popup nor substitute a Pintasan product. Requirement #4 verified in runtime.
(tabs)/index.tsx submitBarcode: matchedVar branch (variation.barcode === scanned code) adds 'Induk — Variasi' directly without popup — this is the Variasi Barcode requirement.
(tabs)/index.tsx submitBarcode: general (children.length > 0 || root.variations?.length > 0) branch opens 'Pilih Variasi {name}' popup — used for classic Variasi (V1) and Biasa-with-variations.
useBarcodeScan.ts: uncontrolled TextInput with buffer in ref + Enter/300ms-pause single finish call — prevents character loss and duplicate submits from HID keystroke storms.
scanKeyboard.ts: gates keyboard suppression behind useIsFocused so background tab layers don't accidentally dismiss keyboards on other screens. Good.
onLocalChange listener in useEffect for loadSlots: correctly refreshes pintasan slots when settings change; unsubscribe returned. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two page.get_by_text('Transaksi') matches are present on 390x844 web preview because <Text>Transaksi</Text> is rendered both in the header of the tab and in the tab-bar label. Always use .all()[-1] (last one = bottom tab-bar) to switch tabs, otherwise you click the page header and stay on the wrong tab. Simulating a hardware scanner in Playwright: page.locator('[data-testid=scan-mode-input]').click(force=True) -> page.keyboard.type(code, delay=5) -> page.keyboard.press('Enter'). Do NOT use page.fill on scan-mode-input; the useBarcodeScan hook relies on the character-stream via onChangeText and Enter via onSubmitEditing. For rapid identical-scan dedup verification, fire two Enter presses without an await in between; the 350ms guard in submitBarcode will discard the second. Miko mascot bubble intercepts clicks on /produk-form Save/Add buttons via dispatch_event; use targeted testIDs and consider scrolling the mascot out of the viewport first, or main agent can add a testing-mode toggle to hide Miko during E2E.
rca_of_issue: Original conflict RCA: previously, when a scanner keystroke storm arrived and a Pintasan chip was concurrently focused, ENTER + newline from the HID scanner could double-submit AND the focused chip's Pressable could receive the Enter as an activation, adding two products (the scanned one AND the chip's). The current fix decouples them: (a) chip Pressables set focusable={false}, so they never keep DOM focus after tap; (b) submitBarcode uses a processingRef lock plus a 350ms same-code dedup; (c) focus is always returned to scan-mode-input in a finally block; (d) unknown barcodes never fall through to any Pintasan path — they simply toast and refocus. Verified end-to-end on live web preview.
